basic_profile.bio: A tech enthusiast from Santa Rosa with a penchant for exploring the unknown. I spend my evenings diving into the latest tech trends and unraveling UFO mysteries. I'm a freelance IT consultant by day, helping small businesses optimize their tech infrastructure. In my free time, I enjoy hiking in the local hills and stargazing. Currently single and always up for a deep conversation about the latest hardware or extraterrestrial theories.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Gained a wealth of tech knowledge through hands-on experience and self-study. My interest in hardware and software began in high school and has grown through online courses and tech forums. My UFO interest started after watching a documentary, and I've been hooked ever since.
